==> /etc/falak/db/kv/server.conf (-rw-r-----)
# Rendered by falak-db at every container start: do not edit, changes are lost.
# Memory limit: 256 MiB

bind * -::*
protected-mode no
port 6379
# falak-db talks to the server over this socket only.
unixsocket /run/falak-db/server.sock
unixsocketperm 700
aclfile /etc/falak/db/kv-acl/users.acl

maxmemory 214748364
maxmemory-policy noeviction

dir /data
dbfilename dump.rdb
save ""
appendonly no

loglevel notice
logfile ""
slowlog-log-slower-than -1
==> /etc/falak/db/kv-acl/users.acl (-rw-------)
user default on #5e884898da28047151d0e56f8dc6292773603d0d6aabbdd62a11ef721d1542d8 ~* &* +@all -config -debug -module
==> tuning
maxmemory = 214748364
